title.description: Slide title Existing segment order/cardinality: Intellio Evolve turns application evidence into modernization guidance and sequencing

proposition.description: Opening product proposition Existing segment order/cardinality: Evolve treats evidence as more than reports: source code, dependency and call graphs, data use, integrations, and functional boundaries. It uses that evidence to recommend modernization options and a sequenced starting point for human review.

step_1_heading.description: First action heading Existing segment order/cardinality: BUILD AN EVIDENCE BASE

step_1_body.description: First action detail Existing segment order/cardinality: Inventory source code, languages, frameworks, files, calls, dependencies, data use, integrations, components, and functional boundaries.

step_2_heading.description: Second action heading Existing segment order/cardinality: GENERATE RECOMMENDATIONS

step_2_body.description: Second action detail Existing segment order/cardinality: Translate evidence into modernization options, target-state considerations, risks, dependencies, and candidate work packages.

step_3_heading.description: Third action heading Existing segment order/cardinality: PROPOSE SEQUENCING

step_3_body.description: Third action detail Existing segment order/cardinality: Suggest where to start and how initiatives may sequence based on coupling, blast radius, feasibility, and value—while preserving assumptions and uncertainty.

qualification.description: Qualification that recommendations are reviewable starting points Existing segment order/cardinality: Recommendations are transparent, reviewable starting points—not final decisions.

human_judgment_heading.description: Human review heading Existing segment order/cardinality: HUMAN JUDGMENT REMAINS CENTRAL

human_judgment_body.description: Human review explanation Existing segment order/cardinality: Product managers and architects validate context, weigh business priorities and constraints, and guide the final modernization roadmap. Evolve accelerates judgment; it does not replace it.
